author: burakdemirph
quote:
Bu oyun Gta serisi değil bu oyun woke kültürünün ayağını yalayan rezil sjw tayfanın içine dahil olup bok ettiği bir başka güzel yapım. 
Listen, man, the game is called *Grand Theft Auto*, yet you can’t even steal a car—either because some idiot women in the office wrote a "cuckold-simp" narrative that might get "ruined," or because the female driver has a meltdown, or because the car belongs to a neighbor, so it’s "off-limits." Even worse, this slut named Lucia can cheat on me over and over again; apparently, if I don’t act like a total slave to her—in a game I’m playing specifically to escape real life—it’s somehow "justified" that she cheats on me? Dude, Mandy’s toenail is sexier than the entirety of Lucia, and you literally can’t sleep with her—or any other woman for that matter—but hey, you *can* sleep with a FAT, HAIRY APE! Screw you, you moronic, feminist **** hell with the game you’ve made! Anyone who doesn’t play a jailbroken or cracked version is an idiot, and anyone leaving a positive review for this game has either been paid off or is just a spineless coward terrified of the company’s pressure. Aside from the graphics, this game doesn’t deserve a single bit of praise. In the entire *GTA* series, I can shoot at anything—a bird in the sky, an innocent squirrel on the ground, even soldiers or cops—but I *can’t* shoot at ****? What makes them so special? Why does this "positive discrimination" exist? It’s absolutely sickening. I’m not even homophobic or anything, but the fact that I can shoot an old person but *can’t* shoot a **** your "honor," you pieces of ****!
